```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Support for the English First approach to ensure all students have access to the mainstream of American life.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to divisive programs that limit students' ability to advance in American society.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Renewal of a call for replacing \"family planning\" programs for teens with sexual risk avoidance education that sets abstinence until marriage as the responsible and respected standard of behavior.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The approach of replacing \"family planning\" programs for teens with sexual risk avoidance education is the only one always effective against premarital pregnancy and sexually-transmitted disease.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Opposition to school-based clinics that provide referral or counseling for abortion and contraception.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Belief that federal funds should not be used in mandatory or universal mental health, psychiatric, or socio-emotional screening programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The federal government has pushed states to collect and share vast amounts of personal student and family data, including the collection of social and emotional data.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Much of the personal student and family data collected by states is collected without parental consent or notice.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This data collection is wholly incompatible with the American Experiment and inalienable rights.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
